name: Lightfield
description: Access and manage your CRM directly from Claude. Search, create, and update accounts, contacts, opportunities, notes, tasks, and lists — all through natural language. Look up records, filter by any field, track deals through your pipeline, and manage your workspace without leaving the conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Lightfield to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Lightfield to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.lightfield.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Lightfield MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lightfield provides these MCP tools: get_current_user, get_lightfield_api_details, read_from_lightfield, search_lightfield_api_docs, and write_to_lightfield.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Lightfield?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Lightfield in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Lightfield requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Lightfield is developed by Lightfield. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
